### Cost-benefit analysis: Expected gain in total production:

```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.width=9, fig.height=5, fig.align="left"}
require(plyr)
require(dplyr)
require(ggplot2)

personalized_info <- read.csv("../temp/PP_MarkDownText.csv")

personalized_info$currency <- ifelse(personalized_info$country == "NG", "NGN",
                                     ifelse(personalized_info$country =="TZ", "TZS",
                                            ifelse(personalized_info$country =="BU", "BIF")))

ds <- read.csv("../temp/PP_rec.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
if(!require("plyr")) install.packages("plyr"); library("plyr")

#create plot with recommendations
ds$ploughing_label <- revalue(ds$method_ploughing, c("N/A" = "no\nploughing",
                                                     "manual" = "manual\nploughing",
                                                     "tractor" = "tractor\nploughing"))
ds$ridging_label <- revalue(ds$method_ridging, c("N/A" = "no\nridging",
                                                 "manual" = "manual\nridging",
                                                 "tractor" = "tractor\nridging"))

ggplot(data=ds[ds$CP==FALSE,], aes(x=ploughing_label, y=ridging_label))+
  geom_tile(aes(fill=dNR), colour="grey95", size=1, alpha=0.2)+
  scale_fill_gradient2(low="royalblue3", high="green", mid="white", midpoint=0)+
  geom_tile(data=ds[ds$CP==TRUE,], colour="black", size=2, fill=NA)+
  geom_tile(data=ds[1,], colour="purple", size=2, fill=NA)+
  geom_text(data=ds[ds$CP==TRUE,], fontface="bold", aes(label="Your current practice"), size=4)+
  geom_text(aes(label=paste0("Net value: ",
                             ifelse(dNR>0, "+ ", ifelse(dNR<0, "- ", " ")),
                             formatC(signif(abs(dNR), digits=3), format="f", big.mark=",", digits=0),
                            personalized_info$currency, "\n"), 
                colour=factor(sign(dNR))),
            fontface="bold", size=4)+  
  geom_text(aes(label=paste0("\n Cost: ",
                             ifelse(dTC>0, "+ ", ifelse(dTC<0, "- ", " ")),
                             formatC(signif(abs(dTC), digits=3), format="f", big.mark=",", digits=0), 
                             personalized_info$currency), 
                colour=factor(-sign(dTC))),
            fontface="bold", size=4)+
  scale_colour_manual(values=c("-1" = "red", "0" = "grey50", "1" = "green3"))+
  geom_text(data=ds[1,], colour="purple", fontface="bold", aes(label="Recommended practice\n\n\n"), size=4)+
  xlab("Ploughing")+
  ylab("Ridging")+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(size=15, colour="black", face="bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(angle=90, hjust=0.5, vjust=-1),
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid = element_blank(), 
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank()
  )
```
